pixelmatch.interpretation: Diagnostic only. Exact AI-rendered Master glyph pixels are intentionally not the clean-DOM typography target; photography force, crop, hierarchy, spacing and section boundaries require human-visible review.

render_evidence.note: Subsequent commits after render_head only document/record this same v2 evidence boundary and do not advance to another section.

hero_v2.label: 施工イメージ / サンプルビジュアル

before.note: v1 used a compressed proxy Expected and low-resolution Master-derived Hero; its mismatch ratio is not numerically comparable to this exact-Master v2 gate.

evidence_boundary: Exact pixelmatch is executed only in an environment where the locked Library Master is mounted. CI captures the deterministic 786/1440 actuals and records their hashes; it does not substitute a proxy Expected.
